context: Normal QQ plot with 95% pointwise confidence envelope for a skewed mixture distribution (200 points, 80% N(0,1) + 20% shifted), with an inset histogram showing distribution vs. normal fit, two-color encoding for inside/outside envelope status, Voronoi tooltip on hover, and a callout annotation on the right-tail deviation.
first_impression: Immediately readable: the rose cluster deviating from the diagonal in the right tail tells the story at a glance without any study.
what_works: The two-color encoding (blue within / rose outside) is perceptually distinct and maps directly to the statistical question being answered; the inset histogram is appropriately scaled and positioned so it adds context without competing with the main view.
what_doesnt: The '95% envelope' label is partially clipped at the right edge of the plot area, reducing its legibility; the callout annotation and inset histogram occupy the same upper-right quadrant and create mild visual crowding that could be resolved by moving the callout or the inset.
